title: geranium robertianum f. minutiflorum
intro: Geranium robertianum f. minutiflorum, commonly known as the dwarf cranesbill or small-flowered cranesbill, is a subspecies of the Geranium robertianum plant, which belongs to the family Geraniaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to treat digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Geranium robertianum f. minutiflorum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect cells from damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include geraniin, flavonoids, and tannins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
